protocol.purpose: Exploratory reconstructed-coordinate handoff; no raster extraction tested
protocol.parent_selection: One parent per original crystal system, minimum SHA256([20261028,parent,material_id]); no outcome selection
protocol.conditions: sigma 0.01, frozen cameras, noise repetition 0, original and large variants, Gaussian and corrupted
protocol.primary_contrast: Split minus Huber downstream correctness on all 28 cases; descriptive parent-cluster bootstrap
protocol.secondary: Original accuracy; stable changed accuracy; paired joint correctness; false restoration; invalid responses; exact geometry and lattice controls
protocol.parser: Exactly one ANSWER: valid_class occurrence, otherwise exact standalone class; invalid counts incorrect; no spelling repairs
protocol.deduplication: Identical prompts share one deterministic response; repeated endpoints are not independent
